It is however, noticed that the revised Form-P (pertaining to IEDC) submitted by the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 5.4.2024, was inadvertently not considered by the Commission, while passing the order dated 20.3.2025. The inadvertent error is required to be rectified on this count. Accordingly, we consider the said affidavit (pertaining to IEDC) and correct the tariff determined vide order dated 20.3.2025, as stated below: “83. The capital cost as per IGAAP, on accrual basis as well as on cash basis amounting to Rs.1324774.94 lakh and Rs.1268206.04 lakh, respectively, as on COD of Unit-II is inclusive of IDC & FC of Rs.202893.33 lakh and FERV of Rs.20336.30 lakh. Accordingly, the hard cost component of capital cost as on COD of Unit-II works out to Rs.1101545.31 lakh on accrual basis and Rs.1044976.41 lakh on cash basis. The hard cost, on accrual as well as on cash basis, as on COD of Unit-II also includes IEDC of Rs.128035.84 lakh. Considering the fact that time overrun of 219 days has not been condoned as on COD of Unit-II, and further considering the details of IEDC as furnished by the Petitioner, IEDC of Rs.19523.77 lakh (Rs.15742.74 lakh towards time overrun not condoned **_plus_** Rs.3781.03 lakh towards adjustment of depreciation capitalized to gross block and forming part of it as on COD of Unit-II) is disallowed. Accordingly, the allowable IEDC as on COD of Unit-II, subject to truing up, works out to Rs.108512.07 lakh. Accordingly, the hard cost considered for the purpose of tariff, as on COD of Unit-II/Station, works out to Rs.1025452.63 lakh (net of un-discharged liabilities of Rs.56568.91 lakh). We now proceed to examine the Petitioner’s claim, subject to truing up, for IDC & FC, FERV, notional IDC and FERV transferred to P&L as under:” 5.
